label: Precharge and evaluate
subgoals: Precharge the output high while the clock is low
Evaluate through the nMOS network when the clock rises
Count transistors as the pull-down network plus precharge and foot

label: Charge sharing
subgoals: Identify the internal nodes the output can connect to during evaluation
Conserve charge to find the shared voltage
Compare the shared voltage with the next stage's switching threshold

label: Monotonicity, domino and keepers
subgoals: Require inputs to rise monotonically during evaluation
Insert a static inverter so domino stages can cascade
Size a weak keeper to hold the node against leakage
